patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: My eye's been red and goopy since yesterday, kind of crusty when I wake up. It's not really painful and my vision's totally fine — my kid had the exact same thing last week.
presentation.triageNote: 28-year-old female with one day of unilateral eye redness, discharge, and crusting on waking. She has no pain, light sensitivity, or change in visual acuity, and her child had the same symptoms last week.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 5 is appropriate because this is a stable uncomplicated red-eye presentation requiring examination, hygiene guidance, and medication only, with no counted emergency resource.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient has a contagious-appearing unilateral red eye without pain, photophobia, or vision loss.
clinical.acuityReason: Discharge, crusting, a household contact, normal vision, and absence of ocular pain support a benign surface process rather than a vision-threatening disorder.
teachingPoints: Eye pain, photophobia, reduced vision, trauma, chemical exposure, or contact-lens complications require a different evaluation.
Hand hygiene and avoiding shared towels reduce transmission.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: A focused eye examination followed by hygiene instructions and topical treatment when indicated would allow discharge.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: seated, lightly pointing at one red, watery eye
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a hispanic 28-year-old woman, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: seated, lightly gesturing at one red, watery eye. Expression: mildly annoyed but otherwise well. Clearly visible: one reddened, watery eye; she otherwise looks healthy. No text, no logos.
